fields.label: Application Rules
fields.description: Each university decides these. EduCore's defaults follow common Namibian practice.

fields.label: Home Country
fields.description: Applicants from anywhere else are international: other documents and fee.

fields.label: Approve Only Once Required Documents Are Verified
Approve Only Once the Fee Is Paid or Waived
Days to Accept an Offer
fields.description: After this, an unanswered offer lapses and the place is released.

fields.label: Reminder Before the Deadline (Days)
fields.description: 0: no reminder.

fields.label: Enrol Only Accepted Offers
fields.description: Online applications only: paper applications are accepted in person.

fields.label: Email Applicants
fields.description: On submission, a rejected document, the decision, a reminder and a lapsed offer.

fields.label: Placeholder Scale
fields.description: Set while the scale is EduCore's sample, not the university's: applicants and staff see a warning.

fields.label: Subjects Counted
fields.description: Points are the sum of the best results in this many subjects.

fields.label: Certification Valid For (Months)
fields.description: A certified copy must have been certified within this many months of submitting. 0: no limit.

fields.label: Fee, Regional Applicants (Online)
fields.description: Citizens of the regional countries below (e.g. SADC). Empty: the international fee.

fields.label: Paper Fee, Local Applicants
fields.description: Paid at a campus when a hard-copy form is handed in.

fields.label: Fee, Regional Applicants (Paper Form)
fields.description: Empty: the international paper fee.

fields.label: Regional Countries
fields.description: Applicants from these countries pay the regional fee.

fields.label: Income Account
fields.description: Where application fees are booked in ERPNext.

fields.label: Bank Account
fields.description: The university’s ERPNext bank account: applicants pay into it, and deposits are matched from its statement. Its bank, number and branch are shown to applicants.

fields.label: Bank (shown to applicants)
fields.description: No longer used: applicants are shown the ERPNext bank account.

fields.label: Account Name (shown to applicants)
fields.description: No longer used: applicants are shown the ERPNext bank account.

fields.label: Account Number (shown to applicants)
fields.description: No longer used: applicants are shown the ERPNext bank account.

fields.label: Branch Code (shown to applicants)
fields.description: No longer used: applicants are shown the ERPNext bank account.

fields.label: Card Payments (DPO)
fields.description: Switched on once the university's DPO merchant account is connected.
